subject: C6f final from lowering-opus: gates + b3a8 status
body: Gates (host only): iOS -Werror syntax PASS default, INERT+COMPOSITOR_DEFAULT_ON, and RENDER_TRACE variants. run_host_tests.sh: all PASS up to the expected final NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN probe step (note: that script relinks build/native/Nord2Metal.bundle). metal_resource_integration_test --candidate (run from work/): 1005 checks, only failure = integration_tests' new CoreAnimation oracle (Item B, natural unaligned strides, being revised); native compute passes when run from work/ (cwd-relative path). Render harness host_test_vs_texture.py PASS. New gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/ca_backboardd_host_test.py PASS ASan+release, 1 explicit PENDING (115,115 planner, Item A). b3a8: I stopped binary-level analysis of QuartzCore; string-level evidence only: QuartzCore contains 'b3a8 unsupported', 'supportsExtendedColors', 'formatWideGamut', 'DisplayPipeStrideRequirements', IOMFB* property keys and per-format pipeline keys 'Pb3a8...'. That does not identify the exact selector of the display format; I cannot give a verified kernel-property/defaults change. Recommend root decide via a device trace run (TEGU_IOSURFACE_REFUSED now records CA's exact descriptor) or the display/kernel owner's own knowledge of what SweetFramebuffer advertises. Files uncommitted.
